owner: fixed wall fixture assembly, never door or movable furniture
suggestion: Normally omit physical collision for this small visual prop; engine may choose a simple coarse proxy if gameplay requires it
support_removal: Engine must decide fixture removal/attachment when its wall support is removed; no persistence/destruction implementation in art
lighting: Engine owns bulb/light type, intensity, color temperature, range, shadow casting and budget; no light exists in GLBs
switch: Visible static pushbutton only; no interaction, electrical connection or gameplay state
